ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic diagram of an island in the Atlantic Ocean. The island outline extends north-south. The figure marks four places: Jia, Yi, Bing, and Ding. Jia is located in the northeastern part of the island, Bing is located in the central-eastern part of the island, Ding is located in the southwestern part of the island, and Yi is located in the western part of the island, near the west coast and where the island body is relatively narrow. In the figure, many rivers flow from within the island toward the coast, and the river near Yi has a relatively short course from the inland to the west coast. Then reason: If redrawn as a contour topographic map, the denser the contour lines, the steeper the slope. Comparing the horizontal distance from the inland highland to the coast near the four places, Yi is near the west coast, and the distance over which the river cuts down or flows to the coast is short, indicating that a similar height difference is completed within a shorter horizontal distance, so the slope is the greatest. Therefore, among the four places, Yi has the densest contour line distribution.
